How do I change the car on my Stonnington visitor permit?

On the council's ePermits site: sign in, choose Update Vehicle on the permit, enter the new plate, save. It has to be done before each visitor parks.

At the council

  1. Sign in at parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au — register first if you haven’t, or reset your password if you’ve never used it.
  2. In your Current Permit list, choose Update Vehicle on the visitor permit.
  3. Enter the new registration and the state it’s registered in, and save.
  4. Repeat for each new visitor, before they park.

You can also ring the council on 03 8290 1333 to have the vehicle changed.

With p.stonn

Set it once. A weekly roster puts the right car on for each day, a one-off booking covers everyone else, and a link lets a regular visitor put their own car on when they arrive.

p.stonn is a free, unofficial tool and is not affiliated with the City of Stonnington. The council’s own pages: visitor parking permits and parking permit FAQs. See also how p.stonn works and the FAQ.
